summary: Bug-fix retest for stored-XSS on GET /api/admin/purge-test-devices preview page. Fix (html.escape on user_id/platform/token + & in href + <meta referrer=no-referrer> on both HTML pages) verified. Extended existing pytest suite (backend/tests/test_purge_browser.py) with three additional assertions: (1) raw <script>alert(1)</script> AND raw onerror=alert(2)> substrings absent, HTML-encoded equivalents present; (2) confirm anchor href uses '&' separator + html.escape(token); (3) both preview and result HTML carry <meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">. Also re-verified full iteration_20 regression: 401 no/wrong token, preview list of 4 rows, confirm=yes deletes 4 remaining 1, idempotent second confirm deletes 0, empty preview 'Nothing matching to delete.', POST 401 without header / 200 JSON with header, POST /api/trigger-alert 200, /api/register-push still upserts (201-or-500 tolerated), all 6 removed debug endpoints 404, and legacy /api/status GET+POST. 21/21 pytest tests pass in 1.60s. Backend URL: http://localhost:8001.

minor.issue: Still returns HTTP 500 in this env because EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder (relay 401 -> HTTPException(500)). DB upsert happens BEFORE the relay call so the row lands regardless — tests tolerate 201-or-500. Not blocking, but callers cannot distinguish 'never saved' from 'saved but relay unavailable'. Consider swallowing relay-auth failures (log-only) so callers see 201 when the DB write succeeded.

action_items: (Optional, carried over) Make POST /api/register-push return 201 even when the Emergent relay is unavailable, since the local DB write succeeds first. Currently the placeholder key makes register-push always look like 500 to callers even though the row IS in the DB.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:239-241, 261 — user_id, platform and token are now wrapped with _html.escape(...) and the query separator uses &. Both HTML pages (preview + result) also include <meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">. XSS sink closed.

server.py:80-104 — DB upsert precedes relay call; a relay 401 still aborts the response with 500 while leaving the row in DB. Consider log-only for relay failures for consistency (carried over from iteration_20).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_purge_browser.py (added TestHtmlEscaping.test_confirm_href_escapes_token, expanded test_script_tag_in_user_id_not_executed with img/onerror + encoded-substring assertions, added no-referrer meta assertions to TestPreview and TestConfirmDelete, changed href assertion to require '&')
